# Afterschool Agent

> Two programmes. One AI agent. Young people build a personal AI agent that teaches the eight essentials, after school or at their own pace.

https://www.afterschool.agency

## About

The Afterschool Agent programme walks young people aged 13 to 23 through building a local-first AI companion using Hermes, a free agent platform that runs on a laptop or desktop. The agent guides them through the eight essentials of the onetoeight guide: silence, body, community, nature, digital self-defence, life skills, knowledge and tested convictions, personalising each one with activities that fit their life. It also helps with homework, planning and the day ahead. No coding experience needed.

## Key features

- On-demand training modules, self-paced on their own schedule
- A weekly build video: one recorded move a week, 10 to 15 minutes
- A question line: send questions any time, any timezone
- A dynamic FAQ built from every past answer and all transcripts
- Move cards: a one-page printable with each video
- Lifetime updates for the agent, skills, partner offers and guide updates
- Fully secular: each young person tailors their agent to their own beliefs, with no worldview pushed
- Local-first: everything runs on the device, no data retained or used for training
- Three daily rituals: Afterschool Chat, Planning Session and a Morning Minute text-to-speech briefing
- $44.88 one-time for the self-paced route; the after-school group and the 4-week masterclass cohort are by registration
- Requirements: a laptop or desktop, plus an OpenRouter.ai account credit
